personality_one_liner: A premium, fast, and highly readable Indian digital news app combining high-quality newspaper authority with modern mobile usability.

typography.guidelines: Use Noto Serif Display for all headlines (Hero, Article, Section, News Card). Use Inter for body text, metadata, navigation, and small UI labels. Saffron is accent only, never a full background.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for reading. Cards have 16dp horizontal padding and 8-16dp vertical spacing.

dont's: No glassmorphism anywhere in the app. This is an editorial app, not a dashboard.
Avoid blur on navigation or headers. Use solid surface colors or borders to separate.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Discover the latest news through a premium hero section, category strips, and scannable feed.

states.loading: Skeleton loader using gray placeholder image and animated text lines. No spinners.
states.empty: No stories found' with retry button, minimal iconography.
states.error: 'You're offline' banner at the top, show cached news below.

screens.layout: Header: Chai Panchayat logo at top-left, Search and Notification icons at top-right. Below header: Horizontal scrollable category chip strip (Latest | India | UP | etc.). Hero Section: 16:9 featured article image with gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse), large Noto Serif headline overlay. Feed: 'Latest News' section header followed by vertical list of news cards. News Cards: Horizontal IMAGE|TEXT layout. Image width 110-130dp, max radius 10dp, very subtle elevation. Animations: 150-250ms fade/slide on cards.

screens.name: Article Detail
screens.purpose: Provide a distraction-free, highly readable article reading experience.

states.loading: Skeleton loader representing the headline and body paragraphs.
states.error: Failed to load article. Retry button.

screens.layout: Scrollable View. Top: Category label (brand color text), large Noto Serif headline (28/34), publication date/time (muted). Featured image (full width). Body: Rendered HTML content (17sp, 1.6 line-height, proper heading/blockquote/list rendering). Bottom/Sticky: Share/Bookmark/Text-size action bar.

screens.name: Search

states.loading: Skeleton list of horizontal news cards.
states.empty: No results found for your query. Try another keyword.
states.error: Error fetching search results. Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky search input at the top with auto-focus. Recent searches chip list below it if query is empty. Results show as a vertical list of horizontal IMAGE|TEXT news cards.

screens.name: Category
screens.purpose: Browse articles specific to a particular category (e.g., India, UP, Sports).

states.loading: Skeleton list of horizontal news cards.
states.empty: No stories found in this category.
states.error: Failed to load category feed. Retry button.

screens.layout: Header with Category Title (Noto Serif). Single vertical list of horizontal news cards. Pull-to-refresh enabled.

screens.name: Saved

states.empty: You haven't saved any stories yet.

screens.layout: Simple vertical list of saved news cards. Swipe left to remove bookmark.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage app preferences, dark mode, and account settings.
screens.layout: List of simple rows (Text + Chevron/Switch). Includes Dark Mode toggle, Text Size preference, Offline Reading cache settings.

india_politics_placeholder.alt: A large crowd holding the Indian flag, suitable for a politics or national news placeholder.

sports_cricket_placeholder.alt: A cricket stadium under a dark red evening sky, suitable for a sports news placeholder.

business_market_placeholder.alt: Stock market candlestick chart on a dark screen, suitable for a business news placeholder.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's specific hex codes for light and dark modes provided in the brief. Saffron (#E85D04) should act only as an accent (selected tabs, buttons, chips, breaking news badges), never as a full screen or card background.
Implement pure 'Editorial Mobile' personality (no glassmorphism, no large shadows, max 10dp radius). Background uses the warm #FFFDF8 and cards use pure #FFFFFF.

Typography MUST use Noto Serif Display for headlines and Inter for UI/Body. Ensure the custom Type Scale is mapped correctly, specifically handling the large 32/38 Hero and 28/34 Article sizes. Line-height is strictly 1.6 (27px on 17px text) for article reading experience.
Cards follow a horizontal IMAGE|TEXT structure. The image should be 110-130dp wide. Keep card padding 16dp horizontal. Use very subtle elevation (almost flat, mostly relying on borders).
Hero cards with text overlapping the image MUST use a gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) to guarantee text contrast. Noto Serif headline overlays on this image.
Use skeleton loading states with animated text lines instead of generic circular spinners for all lists.
The Bottom navigation must have 4 tabs (Home, Categories, Saved, Settings) with MaterialCommunityIcons. Selected is Saffron #E85D04, Unselected #777777.
Implement a '3 new stories' indicator pill that floats subtly over the Home feed when new data is available.
Render the WordPress HTML content properly in Article Detail, maintaining the editorial look (heading/blockquote/list styling).
App icon is already uploaded at /app/frontend/assets/images/logo.png - use it in the Top Header area.
